verdict.rationale: CRA's e-services page lists "track the progress of files submitted to the CRA" among its online services, and EFILE filers can view transmission history. Both are signed-in account features, not lookups from public pages. The public tools in evidence (BN finder, GST/HST registry) are registry searches, not status checks on a founder's own filing or case. missing for 10: status lookup without signing in, detailed docs on what statuses are shown for registrations/returns/cases, hands-on corroboration that tracking works.
